chapters.name: 基础方位——东南西北及复合方向

words.tr:
n. 东方；
adj. 东方的；
adv. 在东方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起。
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun rises at the equinoxes, on the right-hand side of a person facing north.

words.tr:
n. 南方；
adj. 南方的；
adv. 在南方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east and sets in the south.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起，在南方落下。
words.en: The south is the direction which is on your right when you are looking towards the direction where the sun rises.

words.tr:
n. 西方；
adj. 西方的；
adv. 在西方；
words.ex: The address is 1071 West Street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是西街1071号。
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun sets at the equinoxes, on the left-hand side of a person facing north, or the part of the horizon lying in this direction.

words.tr:
n. 北方；
adj. 北方的；
adv. 在北方；
words.ex: The wind is coming from the north.
words.ex_cn: 风从北方吹来。
words.en: The direction that is on your left when you are facing the rising sun.

words.tr:
n. 东北；
adj. 东北的；
words.ex: The storm came from the northeast.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自东北方向。
words.en: The northeast is the direction which is halfway between north and east. It is also the area that lies in this direction.

words.tr:
n. 西南；
adj. 位于西南的；
adv. 向西南；
words.ex: The storm came from the southwest.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自西南方向。
words.en: The southwest is the direction which is halfway between south and west.

words.tr:
n. 西北；
adj. 西北的；
words.ex: The storm is moving from the northwest.
words.ex_cn: 风暴正从西北方向移动。
words.en: The northwest is the direction which is halfway between north and west.

words.tr:
n. 东南；
adj. 位于东南的；向东南的；
words.ex: The storm came from the southeast.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自东南方向。
words.en: The southeast is the direction which is halfway between south and east.

words.tr: adj. 东部的；东方的；
words.ex: The eastern city has many old temples.
words.ex_cn: 东部的城市有许多古老的寺庙。
words.en: Eastern means in or from the east part of an area.

words.tr: adj. 南部的
words.ex: He lives in the southern part of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在城市的南部。
words.en: Located in or characteristic of a region in the south.

words.tr: adj. 西方的；西洋的；西部的；
words.ex: He likes western music and movies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢西方的音乐和电影。
words.en: Western means relating to the countries of the West, especially Europe and America.

words.tr: adj. 北方的
words.ex: The northern wind is cold in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天的北风很冷。
words.en: Northern means situated in, directed towards, or facing the north.

chapters.name: 基础方位——上下/顶点/底部（垂直）

words.tr:
n. 顶；顶部；顶端；
adj. 最高的；极棒的；
v. 胜过；超过；
words.ex: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 山顶上覆盖着雪。
words.en: The highest or uppermost point, part, or surface of something.

words.tr:
prep. 在…上面；
adj. 上述的；
adv. 在上面；
words.ex: The book is above the table.
words.ex_cn: 书在桌子上面。
words.en: In or to a higher place than something else; over.

words.tr: adj. 上面的；上部的；
words.ex: The upper shelf is too high to reach.
words.ex_cn: 上面的架子太高了，够不着。
words.en: Higher in place or position; situated above another part.

words.tr:
prep. 遍于…之上；越过；
adv. 大于；结束；越过；
words.ex: The blanket is over the bed.
words.ex_cn: 毯子盖在床上面。
words.en: In addition to the meanings related to physical position or movement above something, 'over' can also indicate completion, excess, or repetition.

words.tr:
n. 高峰；顶峰；
v. 达到高峰；达到最高值；
words.ex: The mountain peak is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的高峰被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

words.tr: n. 顶峰；首脑会议；
words.ex: The climbers reached the summit of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 登山者到达了山顶。
words.en: The highest point of a hill or mountain; a meeting between heads of government.

words.tr: n. 尖端；建议；窍门；
words.ex: The tip of the pencil broke off.
words.ex_cn: 铅笔的尖端断了。
words.en: The end of a pointed or projecting object; a sum of money given to someone as a reward for their services; to give someone a small amount of money as a reward for their services.

words.tr: n. 最高点；顶点；
words.ex: The apex of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 山的最高点被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or top of something; the climax or culmination of something.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在顶部；在上面；处于最高位置
words.ex: The cat is on the top of the box.
words.ex_cn: 猫在盒子的顶部。
words.en: At the highest part or point of something.

words.tr: n. 底部；底面；尽头；
words.ex: The book fell to the bottom of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书掉到了架子的底部。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.tr:
n. 基础；基地；
v. 以…为基础；
words.ex: The base of the building is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的基础非常坚固。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.tr: n. 盆地；流域；水池；脸盆；
words.ex: The river flows into a large basin.
words.ex_cn: 河流流入一个巨大的盆地。
words.en: A basin is a large or small depression in the Earth's surface or a large container that holds water.

words.tr: prep. 在…下面
words.ex: The cat is beneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: In or to a lower position than someone or something, under someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 较低的；下游的；“low”的比较级； v. 降低；
words.ex: He sat in the lower row of the theater.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在剧院的较低一排。
words.en: If you lower something, you move it slowly downwards. If you lower something, you make it less in amount, degree, value, or quality.

words.tr:
prep. 在…下面；低于；少于；
adv. 在下面；
words.ex: The cat is below the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If something is below something else, it is in a lower position.

words.tr: n. 脚；足底；英尺；
words.ex: He hurt his foot while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了脚。
words.en: The lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks.

words.tr: phrase. 最低点；谷底；最糟糕的时刻
words.ex: The lowest point of the valley is near the river.
words.ex_cn: 山谷的最低点在河流附近。
words.en: The minimum level or value that something reaches.

words.tr: phrase. 左下角；左下方
words.ex: The book is on the left bottom corner of the table.
words.ex_cn: 书在桌子的左下角。
words.en: Located at the lower left area of something.

chapters.name: 基础方位——前后左右/角落（水平）

words.tr: phrase. 在...前面
words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子前面。
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.tr: phrase. 在……前部（指某物体内部的前端位置）
words.ex: The teacher stands in the front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在教室前面。
words.en: At the foremost part or position of something.

words.tr:
n. 前面；前线；
adj. 前面的；
words.ex: The front of the house has a big garden.
words.ex_cn: 房子的前面有一个大花园。
words.en: The front is the part of something that faces forward or is the most important or prominent part.

words.tr:
adv. 回原处；向后；
n. 后面；背部；
v. 支持；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: He put the book back on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放回了书架。
words.en: The back is the rear surface of the human body from the shoulders to the hips.

words.tr:
n. 后部；
v. 饲养；抚养；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: The rear of the car was damaged in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的后部在事故中受损了。
words.en: The back part of something, especially a building or vehicle; to bring up and care for a child until they are fully grown.

words.tr:
n. 结束；尽头；目标；末端；
v. 结束；终止；
words.ex: The end of the movie made everyone cry.
words.ex_cn: 电影的结尾让所有人都哭了。
words.en: The end of something such as a period of time, an event, a book, or a film is the last part of it or the point at which it stops.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；
words.ex: The cat is behind the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发后面。
words.en: If something is behind a thing or person, it is on the far side of them as they face you, or is in a back part of them.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之后；
adv. 以后；后来；
words.ex: I will call you after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚饭后给你打电话。
words.en: In addition to its use as a preposition meaning 'behind in place or time,' 'after' can also function as an adverb to indicate a subsequent time or event.

words.tr: phrase. 在...结尾；在....末端
words.ex: He will call you at the end of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他会在会议结束时给你打电话。
words.en: Indicates the final part of a period of time, an event, a process, or a physical object.

words.tr: 短语. 在远端；在尽头
words.ex: The cat is sleeping at the far end of the bed.
words.ex_cn: 猫正在床的最远端睡觉。
words.en: at the far end: located at the most distant point of something.

words.w: walk down to the back of
words.tr: v. 沿着走到……的后面
words.uk: wɔːk daʊn tu ðə bæk əv
words.us: wɔːk daʊn tu ðə bæk əv
words.ex: He walked down to the back of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着走到房子的后面。
words.en: To proceed along a path or corridor until reaching the rear section of a location.

words.tr: v. 离开；“leave”的过去式和过去分词； n. 左；左边； adj. 左边的； adv. 向左；在左边；
words.ex: He left the house early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上早早离开了家。
words.en: If there is a certain amount of something left, or if you have a certain amount of it left, it remains when the rest has gone or been used.

words.tr:
adv. 正确地；直接地；向右；
adj. 正确的；右边的；
n. 右边；权利；
v. 纠正；
words.ex: He answered the question right.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地回答了问题。
words.en: If something is right, it is correct and agrees with the facts.

words.tr: 短语. 到最右侧；极端右方
words.ex: The book is placed to the extreme right side of the table.
words.ex_cn: 这本书放在桌子的最右边。
words.en: To the farthest right position or location.

words.tr: phrase. （政治光谱中的）极左/极右派
words.ex: He voted for a candidate from the far left.
words.ex_cn: 他投票给了一个来自极左派的候选人。
words.en: The extreme or most radical wing of a political group or ideology.

words.tr: 定冠词 + adj. 上部的 + adj. 下部的 + adj. 左侧的 + adj. 右侧的（常用于描述方位或分区）
words.ex: The button is in the upper left corner.
words.ex_cn: 按钮在左上角。
words.en: Positions relative to a central point: upper, lower, left, or right.

words.tr: phrase. 中间左右
words.ex: Place the item in the middle leftright.
words.ex_cn: 把物品放在中间左右。

words.tr: phrase. 在……的右左；位置不明确
words.ex: The ball is on the rightleft of the chair.
words.ex_cn: 球在椅子的右左。

words.tr: 短语 在右侧
words.ex: Please sign your name on the right hand side of the document.
words.ex_cn: 请在文件的右侧签上你的名字。
words.en: Located to the right of something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 直接在你左右角
words.ex: You will see the entrance directly on your leftright corner.
words.ex_cn: 你会看到入口直接在你的左/右角。

words.tr: phrase. 右上角；右下角；右侧角落
words.ex: The book is in the right-hand corner of the table.
words.ex_cn: 书在桌子的右上角。
words.en: The right-hand corner refers to the corner that is on the right side from a particular perspective or in a specific context.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的角落里
words.ex: The cat is sitting in the corner of the room.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房间的角落里。
words.en: Located at the point where two sides or edges meet, especially where they form a right angle.

words.tr: phrase. 拐角处
words.ex: The cafe is on the corner of Main Street and Park Avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆在主街和公园大道的拐角处。
words.en: At the intersection of two streets or the edge of a building.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的拐角处
words.ex: The café is at the corner of Main Street and Park Avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆在主街和公园大道的拐角处。
words.en: Located at the point where two lines, edges, or sides meet.

words.tr: phrase. 在最左/最右的角落里
words.uk: ɪn ðə fɑː rɪt raɪt ˈkɔːnə(r)
words.us: ɪn ðə fɑr raɪt raɪt ˈkɔrner
words.ex: The book is in the far left corner.
words.ex_cn: 书在左上角。
words.en: Situated in the far left or right corner of an area.

words.tr: phrase. 急转弯；尖角
words.ex: The car took a sharp corner too fast and skidded.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以太快的速度驶过一个急转弯，打滑了。
words.en: A sharp corner refers to a corner that turns at a very acute angle, often requiring caution when navigating.

words.tr: 短语. 在拐角附近；即将到来；就在眼前
words.ex: The store is around the corner.
words.ex_cn: 商店就在拐角处。
words.en: If you say that something is around the corner, you mean that it is very near or will happen very soon.

words.w: on the corner of A and B
words.tr: phrase. 在A路与B路交汇的拐角处
words.uk: ɒn ðə ˈkɔːnə(r) əv eɪ ənd biː
words.us: ɑːn ðə ˈkɔːrnər əv eɪ ənd biː
words.ex: The small shop is on the corner of Main Street and 5th Avenue.
words.ex_cn: 那家小商店在主街和第五大道的拐角处。
words.en: Located at the point where street A meets street B.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲处；
v. （使）弯曲；
words.ex: The car turned at the bend in the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路的拐弯处转弯了。
words.en: To bend something means to change its shape so that it is no longer straight but curved.

chapters.name: 基础方位——表面、边缘与中心（空间）

words.tr:
n. 表面；
v. 显露；
words.ex: The surface of the table is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的表面很光滑。
words.en: The outer or top part of something; to rise to the surface of water or to become known after being hidden or secret.

words.tr:
v. 面对；
n. 脸；
words.ex: He must face his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.tr: n. 地壳；
words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.tr:
prep. 在...外；
n. 外面；外边；外部；
adv. 在外面；
adj. 外面的；外界的；
words.ex: The cat is sitting outside the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子外面。
words.en: The outer side or surface of something; not inside a building; external to a particular place or thing.

words.tr: n. 边缘；优势；刃；锋利；
words.ex: The edge of the table is sharp.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的边缘很锋利。
words.en: The edge of something is the place or line where it stops, or the part of it that is furthest from the middle.

words.tr:
n. 边；边缘；帽边
v. （装）满；（使）溢出
words.ex: The cup is full to the brim.
words.ex_cn: 杯子装得满满的。
words.en: The top edge of a container or the projecting edge of a hat.

words.tr: n. 边缘；边沿；
words.ex: The country is on the brink of war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正处于战争的边缘。
words.en: If you are on the brink of something, you are about to do it or experience it.

words.tr: n. 边缘
words.ex: The bike has a shiny metal rim.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车有一个闪亮的金属轮圈。
words.en: The outer edge of something, especially a circular object.

words.tr: n. 边缘；
words.ex: The fringe of the forest is full of wildflowers.
words.ex_cn: 森林的边缘长满了野花。
words.en: The outer, marginal, or extreme part of an area, group, or sphere of activity.

words.tr: n. 边界；边疆；
words.ex: The river forms the border between the two countries.
words.ex_cn: 这条河是两个国家的边界。
words.en: The edge or boundary of something, or the part near it; a dividing line.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.tr: n. 心；心脏；
words.ex: He felt a pain in his heart.
words.ex_cn: 他感到心脏疼痛。
words.en: The heart is the organ in your chest that pumps the blood around your body. People also use heart to refer to the area of their chest that is closest to their heart.

words.tr: n. 中心；中央；
words.ex: The park is at the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 公园位于城市的中心。
words.en: The middle point or part of something; to place something in the middle of an area.

words.tr:
n. 中间；
adj. 中间的；
words.ex: The ball stopped in the middle of the field.
words.ex_cn: 球停在了场地的中间。
words.en: The middle of something is the part of it that is equally distant from its edges or outer limits.

words.tr: adj. 中央中部的；中元音的（语音学中指舌位处于口腔中部且不高不低的元音）
words.ex: The vowel in 'about' is a mid-central sound.
words.ex_cn: ‘about’中的元音是一个中央中元音。
words.en: Positioned in the middle and central area.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的中心；在……中央
words.ex: The park is in the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 公园位于城市的中心。
words.en: Located at the middle point or main area of something.

chapters.name: 位置关系与距离——邻近关系

words.tr:
prep. 靠近；在…附近；
adj. 近的；
adv. 近地；
words.ex: The cat is near the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫靠近窗户。
words.en: If something is near, it is not far away in distance or time.

words.tr: phrase. 紧邻；在…近旁
words.ex: The book is next to the pen.
words.ex_cn: 书在笔旁边。
words.en: Adjacent to; at the side of.

words.tr: phrase. 与…毗连的
words.ex: The house is adjacent to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子紧邻公园。
words.en: If one thing is adjacent to another, they are next to each other.

words.tr: phrase. 接近于；在附近
words.ex: The cat is close to the box.
words.ex_cn: 猫在盒子旁边。
words.en: Near to someone or something in distance or time.

words.tr: phrase. 在……旁边；在……附近
words.ex: The cat sat by the side of the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在窗户旁边。
words.en: Next to or beside something, along its edge.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的旁边；在……的一侧
words.ex: The cat is sitting at the side of the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫正坐在桌子旁边。
words.en: Situated at the edge or boundary of something.

words.tr: prep. 通过；乘坐；由；被
words.ex: He passed the test by studying hard.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: If something is done by a person or thing, that person or thing does it.

words.tr:
adj. 附近的；
adv. 在附近；
words.ex: There is a park nearby my house.
words.ex_cn: 我家附近有一个公园。
words.en: If something is nearby, it is only a short distance away.

words.tr: 短语. 在不远处；离得不远
words.ex: The park is a short distance away from the school.
words.ex_cn: 公园离学校不远。
words.en: Not far; nearby.

chapters.name: 位置关系与距离——远离关系

words.tr: phrase. 远离；一点也不
words.ex: The village is far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄远离城市。
words.en: If you say that something is far from a particular thing or far from being the case, you are emphasizing that it is not that particular thing or not at all the case, especially when people expect or assume that it is.

words.tr: phrase. 远离...
words.ex: The village is far away from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄离城市很远。
words.en: At, to, or from a great distance in space or time.

words.tr: 短语. 一个街区远；距离一个街区
words.ex: The store is a block away from the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 商店离公交车站只有一个街区远。
words.en: Indicates that something is located the distance of one city block away.

chapters.name: 位置关系与距离——对面与交叉

words.tr:
n. 反面；对立面；
adj. 对面的；
prep. 与…相对；
words.ex: The opposite of black is white.
words.ex_cn: 黑色的反面是白色。
words.en: If one thing is opposite another, it is on the other side of a space from it.

words.tr: v. 面对；“face”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is facing a difficult decision.
words.ex_cn: 他正面对一个艰难的决定。
words.en: Facing can refer to the material that covers the outside of a building or structure, or it can mean to confront or deal with a problem or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 朝向；面对（某方向或某物）
words.ex: The house is facing to the south.
words.ex_cn: 这栋房子朝南。
words.en: prep. in the direction of; towards

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过街道。
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.tr: phrase. 在……对面；与……隔街相对
words.ex: The bank is across from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 银行在邮局的对面。
words.en: prep. on the opposite side of something

words.tr: phrase. 在对面；相反地；在对侧
words.ex: He sits on the opposite side of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在桌子的对面。
words.en: Situated directly across from something else.

words.tr: phrase. 在…的另一边；在…的远端
words.ex: The house is on the far side of the river.
words.ex_cn: 房子在河的另一边。
words.en: Situated on the opposite side of a boundary or area.

words.tr: phrase. 在另一边
words.ex: On the other side of the river, there is a small park.
words.ex_cn: 在河的另一边，有一个小公园。
words.en: Situated on the opposite side of a boundary or area.

words.tr: phrase. 在…的另一端；在…的另一头；在…的另一边
words.ex: He is tired at work, but on the other end of the phone, his daughter is laughing.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中很累，但在电话的另一端，他的女儿正在笑。
words.en: Located at the opposite extremity of a line, path, or object.

words.tr:
v. 横过；穿过；交叉；
n. 十字架；十字形记号；
adj. 恼怒的；
words.ex: Please cross the street carefully.
words.ex_cn: 请小心横过街道。
words.en: To go from one side of something to the other; to place or lie across something else; to oppose.

words.tr: prep. 超出
words.ex: The answer is beyond my understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案超出了我的理解。
words.en: If something is beyond a place or barrier, it is on the other side of it.

words.tr: phrase. 抄近路通过；越（界）；影响，涉及（不同群体）；违背
words.ex: The path cuts across the field.
words.ex_cn: 这条路穿过田野。
words.en: If an issue or problem cuts across different groups of people, it affects or matters to all those groups.

words.tr: phrase. 被理解；讲清楚
words.ex: He tried to get across his idea simply.
words.ex_cn: 他试图简单地表达他的想法。
words.en: To succeed in communicating an idea or piece of information to someone, especially when this is difficult or complicated.

chapters.name: 位置关系与距离——其他关系

words.tr: phrase. 平行的；类似的；相同的
words.ex: The road is parallel to the river.
words.ex_cn: 这条路与河流平行。
words.en: If one thing is parallel to another, it happens at the same time as it or is similar to it.

words.tr: prep. （空间或时间上）在…之间；
words.ex: The cat is sitting between the two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在两把椅子之间。
words.en: If something is between two things or is in between them, it has one of the things on one side of it and the other thing on the other side.

words.tr: prep. 在……和……之间
words.ex: The cat is between the dog and the bird.
words.ex_cn: 猫在狗和鸟之间。

words.tr: phrase. 在一边；在某一侧；单方面地
words.ex: She placed the book on one side of the table.
words.ex_cn: 她把书放在桌子的旁边。
words.en: Situated on one of two opposing sides of something, such as a street or area.

chapters.name: 道路与通道——路口与道路类型

words.tr: n. 交叉；相交；十字路口；交叉路口；
words.ex: The intersection of two roads is busy.
words.ex_cn: 两条路的交叉口很繁忙。
words.en: An intersection is a place where roads or other lines meet or cross.

words.tr: n. 交叉路口；汇合处；
words.ex: The car stopped at the junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A junction is a place where two or more things, especially roads or railways, come together.

words.tr: n. 交叉路；十字路口
words.ex: The car stopped at a crossroad.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A crossroad is a place where two roads meet and cross each other, or a point at which an important decision must be made.

words.tr: n. 丁字路口；T字形接合处
words.ex: The car stopped at the t-junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在T形路口停了下来。
words.en: A T-junction is a place where one road joins another but does not cross it, forming the shape of the letter T.

words.w: at the entry to A from B
words.tr: phrase. 在从b进入a的入口处
words.ex: He waited at the entry to the park from the main road.
words.ex_cn: 他在主路进入公园的入口处等候。
words.en: Positioned at the entrance leading from location B into location A.

words.tr:
n. 旁路；
v. 绕过；
words.ex: The city built a bypass around the old town.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市建了一条绕过老城区的旁路。
words.en: If you bypass a place or a system, you avoid it or go around it instead of going through it.

words.tr: n. 立交桥；高架公路；低空飞行
words.ex: The car drove under the flyover quickly.
words.ex_cn: 汽车快速驶过立交桥。
words.en: A flyover is a bridge that carries one road or railway line over another.

words.tr: n. 天桥；立交桥
words.ex: The car drove under the overpass.
words.ex_cn: 汽车从立交桥下开过。
words.en: An overpass is a bridge that carries one road or railway line over another.

words.tr: n. （铁路或公路下的）地下通道
words.ex: The dog ran under the underpass.
words.ex_cn: 狗从立交桥下跑过去了。
words.en: An underpass is a road or path that goes under another road or a railway.

chapters.name: 道路与通道——人行道与通行设施

words.tr: n. 人行道；路面；
words.ex: Children play on the pavement after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在人行道上玩耍。
words.en: A pavement is a path with a hard surface, usually by the side of a road, that people walk on.

words.tr: n. 人行道
words.ex: He walks on the sidewalk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在人行道上走路。
words.en: A sidewalk is a path with a hard surface by the side of a road that people walk on.

words.tr: n. 道路；车行道；
words.ex: The children played on the roadway.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在道路上玩耍。
words.en: The part of a road intended for vehicles to travel on.

words.tr: phrase. 行人过街道：一个标记的路径，人们可以安全地穿过街道或道路。
words.ex: The child waited at the pedestrian crossing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在人行横道处等待。
words.en: A pedestrian crossing is a designated point on a road at which pedestrians are permitted to cross safely.

words.tr: n. 路标
words.ex: The signpost shows the way to the village.
words.ex_cn: 路标指示了去村庄的路。
words.en: A signpost is a post with a sign on it, giving information such as the direction to a place or the distance to it.

words.tr: n. 绕道；
words.ex: We took a detour to avoid the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们绕道以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A detour is a longer, less direct way to go somewhere, used to avoid a problem or to visit something along the way.

words.tr: v. 走；去
words.ex: He goes to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天去上学。
words.en: To move or travel from one place to another.

words.tr:
v. 转变；转动；转弯；转身；
n. 转变；轮到的机会；
words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在你离开前关掉灯。
words.en: To move or cause to move in a circular direction wholly or partly around an axis or point.

words.tr:
v. 移动；搬家；
n. 行动；移动；
words.ex: Please move the chair.
words.ex_cn: 请移动椅子。
words.en: To change position or to cause something or someone to change position, especially in a particular direction or to a particular place.

words.tr: v. 慢跑；轻碰；轻撞；
words.ex: He jogs every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上慢跑以保持健康。
words.en: To run at a slow, steady pace, especially as a form of exercise.

words.tr:
v. 经营；跑步；
n. 运转；跑；
words.ex: He runs a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家小咖啡馆。
words.en: To move quickly on foot so that both feet leave the ground during each stride.

words.tr:
v. 行走；
n. 步行；
words.ex: I walk to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天步行去学校。
words.en: To move along on foot at a moderate pace; to go on foot for pleasure or exercise.

words.tr:
n. 冲；匆忙；
v. 冲；赶忙做；
words.ex: There was a rush to buy tickets for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 人们争相购买演唱会的票。
words.en: If you rush somewhere, you go there quickly. A rush is a situation in which you need to go somewhere or do something very quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 向东走
words.ex: He goes east to find the sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 他往东走去找日出。
words.en: Move in the direction of the rising sun.

words.tr: phrase. 前进； 进行；赞同
words.ex: The car went along the road slowly.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓慢地沿着路前进。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something, especially a plan or activity; to agree with or support an idea, proposal, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 向左或向右转（常用于指示方向）
words.ex: Turn left at the store, then turn right at the park.
words.ex_cn: 在商店左转，然后在公园右转。
words.en: To change direction to the left or right.

words.tr: phrase. 一直往前走
words.ex: Go straight ahead to find the park.
words.ex_cn: 一直往前走，就能找到公园。
words.en: To continue moving forward in a straight line without turning.

words.tr: phrase. 前进；出发；继续进行
words.ex: The soldiers go forth to defend their country.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们向前推进以保卫他们的国家。
words.en: to proceed or move forward

words.tr: phrase. 进入；出发去（某地）
words.ex: They will go forth into the forest tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进入森林。
words.en: Move forward and into a place or area.

words.tr: phrase. 上升；增长；升起
words.ex: The price of apples will go up next week.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的价格将在下周上涨。
words.en: If a price, amount, or level goes up, it becomes higher or greater than it was.

words.tr: phrase. 下沉；坠落；下降；被接受；传下去；被咽下
words.ex: The sun goes down in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在傍晚落下。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower place or position; to decrease in size, amount, or intensity; to be accepted or believed; to happen or take place.

words.tr: phrase. 经过；走过……旁边
words.ex: He went past the store without stopping.
words.ex_cn: 他经过商店却没有停下。
words.en: To move past something or someone; to exceed a certain point in time or space.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 抄近路通过；越（界）；影响，涉及（不同群体）；违背
words.ex: The path cuts across the field.
words.ex_cn: 这条路穿过田野。
words.en: If an issue or problem cuts across different groups of people, it affects or matters to all those groups.

words.tr: phrase. 被理解；讲清楚
words.ex: He tried to get across his idea simply.
words.ex_cn: 他试图简单地表达他的想法。
words.en: To succeed in communicating an idea or piece of information to someone, especially when this is difficult or complicated.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；
words.ex: The cat is behind the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发后面。
words.en: If something is behind a thing or person, it is on the far side of them as they face you, or is in a back part of them.

chapters.name: 出入口与空间结构——出入口

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.tr: n. 入口；
words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.tr: phrase. 门厅；入口大厅
words.ex: The children are waiting in the entrance hall.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在入口大厅里等待。
words.en: An entrance hall is a large room or area at the entrance of a building.

words.tr: n. 大厅；游说团队；
words.ex: We waited in the hotel lobby for our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们在酒店的大厅里等我们的朋友。
words.en: A lobby is a large room or hall in a building, often used for meetings or as a waiting area. As a verb, to lobby means to try to influence politicians or officials on a particular issue.

words.tr: n. 大厅；礼堂；门厅；
words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在大厅里集合。
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.tr: n. 出口；
words.ex: The exit is near the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 出口在楼梯附近。
words.en: To exit means to go out of or leave a place.

words.tr: phrase. 出路；解决办法
words.ex: He found a way out of the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了走出黑暗房间的路。
words.en: A way out is a means of escape or exit from a place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 紧急出口
words.ex: The children ran to the emergency exit.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们跑向紧急出口。
words.en: An emergency exit is a door or other way out of a building, vehicle, or other place, that is used in an emergency.

chapters.name: 出入口与空间结构——门与附加结构

words.tr: phrase. 后门；秘密途径
words.ex: He left the house through the back door.
words.ex_cn: 他从后门离开了房子。
words.en: A back door is a door at the back of a building, or a way of achieving something secretly or unofficially.

words.tr: phrase. 侧门；旁门
words.ex: He entered the house through the side door.
words.ex_cn: 他从侧门进了房子。
words.en: A side door is a door at the side of a building, not the main door.

words.tr: phrase. 小门；便门（通常设在大门或围墙中，供行人通行）
words.ex: He opened the wicket door to let the dog out.
words.ex_cn: 他打开了小门让狗出去。
words.en: A small, often narrow door, typically found within a larger gate or wall, allowing passage without opening the main entrance.

words.tr: phrase. 后门；车辆尾门
words.ex: He opened the rear door to get the suitcase.
words.ex_cn: 他打开后门拿行李箱。
words.en: The back entrance of a building or vehicle.

words.tr: n. 附属物；
words.ex: The house has a small annex for storage.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个用于存放物品的小附属物。
words.en: To annex means to take control of a country, region, etc., especially by force; to add an area or region to a country, state, etc. : to take control of (a territory or place).

words.tr: n. 走廊
words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.tr: n. 镇；城镇；市镇；
words.ex: He lives in a small town near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他住在山附近的一个小镇上。
words.en: A town is a place with many streets and buildings, where people live and work. It is larger than a village but smaller than a city.

words.tr: n. 城市
words.ex: He lives in a big city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个大城市里。
words.en: A city is a large town where many people live and work.

words.tr: phrase. 主厅；主馆；正厅
words.ex: The children are playing in the main hall.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在主厅里玩耍。
words.en: The principal or largest room in a building, used for gatherings or events.

words.tr: phrase. 商业区；大商场；大型购物中心
words.ex: We went to the shopping mall to buy clothes and eat dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们去商业区买衣服和吃晚饭。
words.en: A shopping mall is a large building or group of buildings containing a variety of stores and often restaurants and other business establishments situated close together.

words.tr: n. 超市；超级市场；
words.ex: I buy milk and bread at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A large self-service store selling foods and household goods.

words.tr: phrase. 汽车站；长途汽车站（专供长途客车停靠和乘客上下车的场所）
words.ex: The bus stops at the coach station near the city center.
words.ex_cn: 公共汽车在市中心附近的长途汽车站停靠。
words.en: A coach station is a place where long-distance buses start and finish their journeys, and where passengers can get on and off.

words.tr: phrase. 中央火车站
words.ex: He waits for the train at the central railway station.
words.ex_cn: 他在中央火车站等火车。
words.en: The main railway station in a city, often the largest and most important one, serving as a central hub for passenger and freight trains.

words.tr: phrase. 火车站
words.ex: He walks to the train station every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去火车站。
words.en: A train station is a place where trains regularly stop so that passengers can get on or off, or goods can be loaded or unloaded.

words.tr: n. 银行；岸；
words.ex: I deposited money at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我到银行存了钱。
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.tr: n. 餐厅；餐馆；
words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.tr: phrase. 邮局
words.ex: He went to the post office to send a letter.
words.ex_cn: 他去邮局寄信。
words.en: A post office is a public department or corporation responsible for mail services, including the acceptance, transmission, and delivery of letters and parcels.

words.tr: n. 医院
words.ex: He went to the hospital because he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感觉不舒服去了医院。
words.en: A hospital is a place where people who are ill or injured are treated and taken care of by doctors and nurses.

words.tr: phrase. 健康中心；医疗中心（提供基本医疗服务的机构）
words.ex: He went to the health centre for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去健康中心做检查。
words.en: A health centre is a building or a place where people can go for medical treatment or advice.

words.tr: 牙医
words.ex: I visited the dentist for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 我去牙医那里做了检查。
words.en: A person who examines and treats teeth professionally.

words.tr: phrase. 茶馆；供人饮茶和社交的场所
words.ex: They drink tea in a small tea house.
words.ex_cn: 他们在一家小茶馆里喝茶。
words.en: A tea house is a place where tea is served, often with light snacks or meals, and sometimes offering a space for social gatherings or relaxation.

words.tr: n. 条状物；酒吧；栅栏；棒；
words.ex: He ate a chocolate bar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一条巧克力。
words.en: A bar is a place where alcoholic drinks are served, or a long, narrow piece of metal or wood used for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 俱乐部；棍子；
words.ex: He joins a chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick used as a weapon or for hitting a ball in sports.

words.tr: n. 健身房；体育馆；
words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.tr: phrase. 咖啡馆；咖啡店
words.ex: He drinks coffee at the coffee shop every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在咖啡店喝咖啡。
words.en: A coffee shop is a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold.

words.tr: n. 咖啡馆
words.ex: He drinks coffee at a small cafe.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小咖啡馆喝咖啡。
words.en: A cafe is a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold.

words.tr: n. 里程碑；地标；
words.ex: The invention of the wheel was a landmark in human history.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的发明是人类历史上的一个里程碑。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a landscape that is easily seen and recognized from a distance, especially one that enables someone to establish their location.

words.tr: adj. 圆圈的；环形的；循环的；
words.ex: The table has a circular top.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子有一个圆形的桌面。
words.en: Something that is circular is shaped like a circle.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用笔画了一个圆。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.tr: adj. 三角的；三角形的；
words.ex: The pizza was cut into a triangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 比萨被切成三角形。
words.en: Something that is triangular has three straight sides and three angles, or is shaped like a triangle.

words.tr: n. 三角形；三角形物；
words.ex: The triangle has three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条边。
words.en: A triangle is a shape consisting of three straight lines and three angles.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.tr: adj. 方形的；呈方形的
words.ex: The box is square-shaped.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是方形的。
words.en: Having the shape of a square; characterized by equal sides and right angles.

words.tr: n. 矩形；长方形
words.ex: The box has a rectangle shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是长方形的。
words.en: A rectangle is a four-sided flat shape where every interior angle is a right angle (90°). Opposite sides are parallel and of equal length.

words.tr: adj. 矩形的；长方形的；
words.ex: The table has a rectangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是矩形的。
words.en: Something that is rectangular has the shape of a rectangle.
